items.originalTitle: Max Verstappen’s Portimao team-mates: who are Chris Lulham and Ben Barnicoat?
items.summaryEn: Max Verstappen will drive the No. 3 Mercedes-AMG GT3 EVO alongside Chris Lulham and Ben Barnicoat this weekend as an experienced reserve. Who are these two teammates and should the 61-car field be worried?
detailZh: 维斯塔潘波尔蒂芒GT3队友：克里斯·卢勒姆和本·巴尼科特是谁？
三人本周末将共用一辆梅赛德斯-AMG GT3 EVO赛车
#31 埃米尔·弗雷车队法拉利296 GT3：马克斯·维斯塔潘、克里斯托弗·卢勒姆
马克斯·维斯塔潘本周末将投身于他的GT3副业。他并非维斯塔潘车队的常规车手，但本周末他将作为一位经验相当丰富的替补出战。他将驾驶3号梅赛德斯-AMG GT3 EVO赛车，与克里斯·卢勒姆和本·巴尼科特并肩作战。但这两位才华横溢的先生是谁？拥有61辆赛车的参赛阵容是否应该感到担忧？
如果你关注维斯塔潘在F1之外的赛车活动，你很可能会认出卢勒姆。他在2026年一直是维斯塔潘赛车的常客。他来自模拟赛车世界，在四届冠军本人的支持下，跳入了现实世界的GT赛车。他和这位红牛车手有着极佳的默契和深厚的合作历史。相比其他新加入者，他有一个领先优势：他已经知道车队是如何运作的。
巴尼科特拥有非常辉煌的赛车历史。这位出生于切斯特菲尔德的英格兰人是雷克萨斯厂队车手。他在IMSA比赛中为瓦瑟·沙利文驾驶14号雷克萨斯RC F GT3赛车。
在迈凯伦厂队车手计划度过四年后，他于2022年转投雷克萨斯，并立即展现出速度。他在2022年伊始便驾驶迈凯伦赢得亚洲勒芒系列赛GT冠军，随后在加盟雷克萨斯的首个赛季赢得小勒芒。之后，他与杰克·霍克斯沃思搭档，赢得2023年IMSA GTD Pro冠军。2024年，他又在赛百灵赢得GTD Pro胜利。
他的GT实力也很强。巴尼科特在2021年曾两次夺得GT世界挑战赛欧洲站杆位，因此本周末他的驾驶表现备受期待。
#14 Vasser Sullivan Racing 雷克萨斯 RC F GT3：杰克·霍克斯沃斯、本·巴尼科特
周五的排位赛将于当地时间下午5点55分开始。三位车手各自在各自的环节中做出一个单圈成绩，发车位由三人的平均成绩决定。
正赛于当地时间10月17日星期六下午5点开始。
detailEn: Max Verstappen’s Portimao team-mates: who are Chris Lulham and Ben Barnicoat?
The trio will share a Mercedes-AMG GT3 EVO this weekend
#31 Emil Fray Racing Ferrari 296 GT3: Max Verstappen, Christopher Lulham

Max Verstappen is embedding himself in his GT3 side hustle this weekend. He's not a regular in the Verstappen Racing team, but he'll be taking over this weekend as a rather well-experienced reserve. He will be driving the No. 3 Mercedes-AMG GT3 EVO alongside Chris Lulham and Ben Barnicoat. But who are these two talented gentlemen? And should the 61-car field be worried?

You will likely recognise Lulham if you follow Verstappen's racing outside Formula 1. He has been a regular in Verstappen Racing cars in 2026. He comes from the sim racing world, having made the jump into real-world GT machinery with support from the four-time champion himself. He and the Red Bull driver have great chemistry and a strong history. He has a head start on the other newcomer here: he already knows how the team operates.
Barnicoat has a really strong history of racing. The Chesterfield-born Englishman is a Lexus factory driver. He races the #14 Lexus RC F GT3 for Vasser Sullivan in IMSA competition.

After spending four years with McLaren's factory driver programme, he moved to Lexus in 2022 and was immediately on the pace. He started 2022 by winning the Asian Le Mans Series GT title in a McLaren, then won Petit Le Mans in his first season with Lexus. He then won the 2023 IMSA GTD Pro title paired with Jack Hawksworth. A Sebring GTD Pro win followed in 2024.
He's got strong GT chops, too. Barnicoat took two GT World Challenge Europe pole positions back in 2021, so there's plenty of excitement around his driving this weekend.
#14 Vasser Sullivan Racing Lexus RC F GT3: Jack Hawksworth, Ben Barnicoat
Friday's qualifying will start at 5.55pm local time. Each of the three drivers sets a lap in their own session, and the grid is decided by the average of the three.
The race starts on Saturday 17 October at 5pm local time.

在2024赛季中期被威廉姆斯车队招募后，科拉平托成为自2004年以来首位为F1参赛超过20年的阿根廷车手，受到了祖国的大力支持。

科拉皮尼奥之前曾公开反对网络骚扰，但多次表示这更多是社会问题，而不是粉丝群体中的特定问题。他的立场现在似乎已经改变。
莱昂内尔·梅西在迈阿密大奖赛维修区与科拉皮尼奥见面。
在社交媒体上发布的一段视频中，科拉皮尼奥说："大家好。有一件非常重要的事情我一直想跟你们谈谈。"
“我可能本应该早点和你们所有人说，但这是需要被解决的事情，是我们需要改变和改进的事情。”
“我将永远感激，我真心觉得非常幸运，从一开始就有你们所有人支持我。”
“我感激你们给予我的所有支持，感激你们如何帮助我取得成绩，以及你们如何不断推动我设定更高的目标。”
Ted Kravitz 前往布宜诺斯艾利斯，与阿根廷本土英雄 科拉平托 会面，讨论一级方程式如何在他的家乡变得如此受欢迎。
“你帮助我和车队一次又一次、一天又一天地取得成绩，我们在训练中努力提高。对此，我由衷地表示感谢。”
“我知道当我取得好成绩，为自己和车队赢得分数时，你感到无比自豪。我一直非常感激这种支持。”
“但有时，我们做得太过分了。”
“在阿斯顿·马丁车队队友之间发生碰撞导致兰多·诺里斯在阿塞拜疆大奖赛中被淘汰后，安全车重启后发生了混乱。”
“我们本应支持我，却最终变成了批评他人，攻击其他车手、同事、队友、我的机械师、我的工程师——这些人是我每天一起工作的人。”
“我知道你以为你在为我辩护，但实际上你做的是相反的事情。你既没有帮助我，也没有帮助我的未来。”
“有几起明显的司机面临网络暴力的案例，这些情况似乎与科拉平托的粉丝群体有关。”,
科拉平托分享了加斯利和Flavio Briatore对他阿塞拜疆大奖赛事故的回应。
2025赛季开始时，杰克·多豪恩遭到了严重的敌意，在阿尔卑斯车队在六轮后用科拉平托替换澳大利亚车手之前。
然后，在2026赛季期间，在科拉平托在荷兰大奖赛受到处罚后，国际汽联赛事裁判遭到了侮辱，在9月份的西班牙大奖赛后，他的队友皮埃尔·加斯利对收到的"令人不安"的威胁进行了抨击。
随后，世界冠军兰多·诺里斯在对科拉平托在阿塞拜疆大奖赛中造成的事故导致他退赛后的严厉批评后，也遭到了侮辱。
兰多·诺里斯反思了他对弗朗哥·科拉平托的批评。
诺里斯后来为他对科拉平托的评论道歉，但阿尔卑斯再次发表声明谴责社交媒体上的滥用行为。
八月份，阿尔卑斯确认了科拉平托的续约，他将与车队一起参加2027赛季，续约期为一年。
他对这个消息的反应很好，在九月初的意大利和西班牙比赛中取得了积分，但自那以后的三场比赛中未能得分。

detailEn: Franco Colapinto: Alpine driver urges fans to stop online abuse amid concerns it is damaging his career

Franco Colapinto's Alpine team have had to condemn online abuse on several occasions following contentious incidents involving the Argentine driver; watch every session of the United States GP in Austin on October 23-25, live on Sky Sports F1
Alpine driver Franco Colapinto has asked his fanbase to stop directing online abuse at other Formula 1 drivers and figures within the sport because it is "not helping" his career.

After becoming the first Argentine driver to compete in F1 for more than 20 years when he was drafted in by Williams midway through the 2024 season, Colapinto has received huge support from his home nation.
However, since Colapinto joined Alpine in 2025, the team have had to issue several statements condemning online hate and abuse following incidents involving the 23-year-old driver.

Colapinto had previously spoken out against online abuse but suggested on several occasions that it was a societal issue rather than a specific problem with his fanbase. His position now appears to have changed.
Lionel Messi meets Franco Colapinto in the paddock at the Miami Grand Prix.
In a video posted on social media, Colapinto said: "Hello everyone. There's something very important that I've needed to talk to you about for some time.
"I probably should have spoken to all of you sooner, but this is something that needs to be addressed, something we need to change and improve.
"I will always be grateful, and I genuinely feel incredibly fortunate to have had you all supporting me from the very beginning.
"I'm grateful for all the support you give me, for how you help me achieve results, and for how you constantly push me to aim higher.
Ted Kravitz visits Buenos Aires to catch up with Argentina's local hero Franco Colapinto to discuss how Formula 1 has become so popular in his home country.
"You help me and the team achieve our results, race after race, day after day, as we train and try to improve. And I'm genuinely grateful for all of that.
"I know it makes you incredibly proud when things go well for me, when I score points for myself and the team. And I have always been very grateful for that support.
"But sometimes, we go too far.
There was carnage on the safety car restart after contact between Alpine team-mates resulted in Lando Norris crashing out of the Azerbaijan Grand Prix.
"Instead of supporting me, we end up criticising people and attacking other drivers, other colleagues, my team-mates, my mechanics, my engineers - people I work with every single day.
"I know you think you're defending me, but you're actually doing the opposite. You're not helping me or my future."
There have been several notable incidents of drivers facing online abuse in situations that appeared to be related to Colapinto's fanbase.
Franco Colapinto shares the response of Pierre Gasly and Flavio Briatore to his Azerbaijan GP crash.
There was major hostility towards Jack Doohan at the start of the 2025 season before Alpine replaced the Australian driver with Colapinto after just six rounds.

Then, during the 2026 season, FIA race stewards were abused after Colapinto received a penalty at the Dutch Grand Prix, before his team-mate Pierre Gasly hit out at "disturbing" threats he received following the Spanish Grand Prix in September.

Reigning world champion Lando Norris then received abuse after making heavily critical comments about Colapinto after the Argentine caused a crash that took him out of the race during the Azerbaijan Grand Prix.
Lando Norris reflects on his critical comments about Franco Colapinto.
Norris later apologised for his comments about Colapinto, but Alpine once more issued a statement condemning social media abuse.
In August, Alpine confirmed a one-year contract extension for Colapinto to remain with the team for the 2027 season.
He responded well to that news with points-scoring results in Italy and Spain at the start of September, but has failed to score at the three races since.

items.titleZh: 维斯塔潘与罗西的GT3赛车对比
items.summaryZh: 维斯塔潘的梅赛德斯-AMG与罗西的宝马GT3赛车在涡轮数量和声音上截然不同，但规则旨在使它们速度相等。两位车手将在本周六在波尔蒂马奥举行的GT世界挑战赛欧洲耐力杯决赛中一较高下。

items.originalTitle: Max Verstappen vs Valentino Rossi: How Their GT3 Cars Compare
detailZh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘与瓦伦蒂诺·罗西：他们的GT3赛车如何比较
这对组合将在周六的GT世界挑战赛欧洲决赛中参加顶级职业组别比赛
GTWC欧洲波尔图：关于马克斯·维斯塔潘的决赛赛事信息
赛车文化超越赛道。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计和那些让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事。
马克斯·维斯塔潘的梅赛德斯-AMG和瓦伦蒂诺·罗西的宝马是两款截然不同的车型，拥有不同数量的涡轮和完全不同的引擎声浪。但规则手册旨在使它们达到相同的速度。两位车手将在本周六在波尔蒂马奥举行的GT世界挑战赛欧洲耐力杯决赛中一决高下，但他们的选择武器如何比较呢？
本周末的赛场上共有61辆赛车，维斯塔潘替补出场，因为常规车手朱尔斯·贡农和丹尼尔·琼卡德尔将在巴塞罗那的世界耐力锦标赛轮次中参赛。这意味着这位一级方程式车手和MotoGP传奇人物将在顶级职业类别中正面交锋。
维斯塔潘赛车队的梅赛德斯-AMG车队将派出梅赛德斯-AMG GT3 EVO赛车，车手为克里斯·卢尔汉和本·巴尼科特，由2 Seas Motorsport车队在赛道上管理。车队原本驾驶阿斯顿·马丁赛车，后来于2026年转投梅赛德斯。
该车搭载的是M159，一款自然吸气6.3升V8发动机。该单元提供大约550马力，但功率输出会根据性能平衡规则进行调整，该规则旨在标准化GT3类别的性能。
布局为后轮驱动，配备前置中置发动机，六速顺序变速箱，重量约为1,285kg，这也是由BoP决定的。

罗西的46号宝马M4 GT3 EVO，由WRT车队运营，采取了不同的方法。它的P58是一款源自道路汽车发动机的3.0升（2,993cc）双涡轮增压直六发动机，在BoP之前可以产生“高达590马力”。它使用六速Xtrac变速箱，全长5,020mm，带有导流板和机翼，轴距为2,917mm，前轮配备390mm刹车盘和六活塞卡钳，后轮配备380mm刹车盘。罗西的队友是宝马工厂车手马克斯·赫塞和尼尔·维尔哈根。
自2025年首秀以来，EVO车型优先考虑了可及性、耐用性和成本效益，而不是原始速度。M4 GT3在其赛车生涯中积累了超过70场胜利，包括2023年斯帕24小时耐力赛和2022年DTM锦标赛的胜利。
从纸面上看，宝马拥有更多的动力，但BoP旨在抵消这一优势，所以两辆车都没有任何优势。两辆车都采用前置发动机后轮驱动和顺序变速箱，并且都配备了390mm的前刹车。真正将它们区分开来的是引擎声：低沉的V8引擎声与高音调的涡轮增压六缸引擎声。
#46 Team WRT, 宝马M4 GT3 EVO: Max Hesse, 瓦伦蒂诺·罗西
车手们如何比较？
维斯塔潘的GT3赛车记录虽然短暂但令人印象深刻。维斯塔潘在2025年9月27日的纽博格林NLS9赛事中，首次参赛就取得了胜利，他与Lulham共同驾驶法拉利296 GT3赛车，从第一圈开始就掌控了比赛，最终领先超过20秒夺冠。
在2026年纽博格林24小时耐力赛中，他驾驶编号3的梅赛德斯赛车领跑，但在比赛还剩大约三个小时时，传动轴故障发生了。姐妹车编号80最终获胜——这是梅赛德斯自2016年以来在那里的首次胜利。
47岁的罗西，这位九次摩托车世界冠军，自2022年以来一直代表WRT车队参加GT3赛车比赛。最初他驾驶奥迪赛车，但从2023年开始转向宝马赛车，并一直驾驶这个品牌的赛车。
他的记录包括在2023年、2024年和2025年连续三年在他的主场赛事中获胜，这三年的胜利都是驾驶M4赛车取得的。除此之外，他在2024年和2025年的世界耐力锦标赛GT3类别中取得了多次前三名的成绩。
罗西本人似乎很清楚他所面临的挑战。他说：“马克斯·维斯塔潘将会是一个巨大的问题，因为这家伙的速度太快了。”由于平衡配重（BoP）使得赛车水平一致，他的说法并不错。
detailEn: Max Verstappen vs Valentino Rossi: How Their GT3 Cars Compare
The pair will race in the top-level Pro category during Saturday’s GT World Challenge Europe finale
GTWC Europe Portimao: Alle Infos zum Finalrennen mit Max Verstappen
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.

Max Verstappen's Mercedes-AMG and Valentino Rossi's BMW is very different cars with a different number of turbos and a totally different soundtrack. But the rulebook is designed to make them equally fast. The two drivers will race this Saturday at Portimao in the final round of the GT World Challenge Europe Endurance Cup, but how do their weapons of choice compare?

It's a 61-car grid this weekend with Verstappen stepping in because regulars Jules Gounon and Daniel Juncadella are committed to the World Endurance Championship round at Barcelona. This means the Formula 1 ace and MotoGP legend will be going head to head in the top-level Pro category.

The Mercedes-AMG Team Verstappen Racing entry fields a Mercedes-AMG GT3 EVO with drivers Chris Lulham and Ben Barnicoat, managed on track by 2 Seas Motorsport. The team moved to Mercedes for 2026 after originally racing Aston Martins.

Powering the car is the M159, a naturally aspirated 6.3-litre V8 engine. The unit delivers approximately 550 horsepower, though power outputs adjust according to Balance of Performance regulations, which function to standardise performance across the GT3 category.
The layout is rear-wheel drive with a front-mid-mounted engine, a six-speed sequential gearbox and a weight of about 1,285kg, also set by BoP.

Rossi's No. 46 BMW M4 GT3 EVO, run by Team WRT, takes a different approach. Its P58 is a 3.0-litre (2,993cc) twin-turbo straight-six derived from the road car's engine, producing "up to 590hp" before BoP. It uses a six-speed Xtrac gearbox, measures 5,020mm long with splitter and wing on a 2,917mm wheelbase, and stops with 390mm front discs and six-piston calipers, plus 380mm discs at the rear. Rossi's co-drivers are BMW factory pair Max Hesse and Neil Verhagen.

Since its 2025 debut, the EVO has prioritised accessibility, durability, and cost-effectiveness over raw pace. The M4 GT3 has accumulated over 70 victories across its racing career, including victories at the 2023 Spa 24 Hours endurance race and the 2022 DTM championship.

On paper, then, the BMW has more power, but the BoP aims to neutralise that advantage, so neither car carries any advantage. Both vehicles employ front-mounted engines with rear-wheel drive and sequential transmissions, and they both employ 390mm front brakes. What really separates them is the engine note: a booming V8 versus a higher-pitched turbo six.
#46 Team WRT, BMW M4 GT3 EVO: Max Hesse, Valentino Rossi
How do the drivers compare?

Verstappen's GT3 record is short but impressive. Verstappen achieved victory in his debut race on 27 September 2025 at the Nurburgring NLS9 event, sharing a Ferrari 296 GT3 with Lulham and controlling the race from the opening lap to finish ahead by more than 20 seconds.

At the 2026 Nurburgring 24 Hours he led in the No. 3 Mercedes until a driveshaft failure struck with about three hours left. Sister car No. 80 went on to win - Mercedes' first victory there since 2016.

The 47-year-old Rossi, a nine-time motorcycle world champion, has competed in GT3 racing with Team WRT since 2022. Originally he drove Audis, but moved to BMW machinery from 2023 and has driven with the marque since.

His record includes three consecutive wins at the Misano Sprint, his home race, across 2023, 2024, and 2025, all achieved driving the M4. In addition to this, he scored multiple top-three finishes in the 2024 and 2025 LMGT3 seasons in the World Endurance Championship's GT3 category.

Rossi himself seems to know what he's up against. "Max Verstappen is going to be a huge problem because the bloke is just so incredibly fast," he said. With the machinery levelled by BoP, he's not wrong.

detailZh: 乔治·拉塞尔在新加坡大奖赛事故后被迫使用二手梅赛德斯部件赛车
梅赛德斯在乔治·拉塞尔的冲刺赛事故后耗尽了新鲜备件，迫使他们使用性能较低的旧部件
对于梅赛德斯车迷来说，这里是关于银箭的最新消息，包括一级方程式新闻、车手更新、赛车发展和比赛分析，来自布拉克利和布里克斯沃斯
乔治·拉塞尔的2026年新加坡大奖赛在纸面上已经是一场确定的噩梦。我们已知他必须吞下60个位置的巨大引擎处罚，与一个决定变软的刹车踏板作斗争，并在驾驶舱里烘烤了两个小时，同时一个破裂的饮料瓶泄漏出神秘液体洒了他一身。
但是，多亏了一些来自德国车队的内部消息，原来他的周日驾驶实际上比看起来还要艰难。
在周六混乱的冲刺赛中，拉塞尔将赛车撞进护栏后，他不仅伤害了自己的自尊心，还彻底摧毁了布拉克利车队的全新碳纤维库存。
当梅赛德斯车队的机械师周六晚上将拉塞尔损坏的W17赛车拖回车库时，维修费用巨大。据《Auto Motor und Sport》报道，车队被迫更换了前翼、地板、前悬挂和整个车尾。
但是，这次碰撞消耗了如此多的库存，以至于车队完全耗尽了全新的备件。
马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队，乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯
工程师们没有安装全新的、工厂般精密的部件，而是不得不在车库后面翻找，使用之前用过的部件来重建赛车。基本上，梅赛德斯不得不让拉塞尔周日驾驶一辆认证的二手弗兰肯斯坦赛车参赛。
在F1推特上还没有开始炒作梅赛德斯主动破坏拉塞尔以利于基米·安东内利阴谋论之前，让我们看看事实。安装在拉塞尔底盘上的二手部件与全新的部件具有完全相同的空气动力学规格。
然而，一级方程式赛车是暴力虐待的机器。碳纤维弯曲，地板在路面上刮擦，悬挂臂在路沿上撞击。AMuS指出，因为这些回收的部件已经在之前的周末赛事中经受住了考验，它们本质上提供的原始性能比全新的部件要低。
突然，托托·沃尔夫拿起麦克风，称赞拉塞尔的P9完赛是一种成功的"损害限制"，这让人更有道理。从第19位发车并在街道赛道上得分已经足够困难。在零件磨损导致其空气动力学咬合度降低的拼凑起来的车上做到这一点实际上相当令人印象深刻。
下次你在F1视频游戏中锁死车辆并撞毁你的车，然后随意按下"闪回"按钮时，别忘了那些在凌晨2点亲自将这些部件粘合在一起的现实生活中的机械师。
detailEn: George Russell forced to race with used Mercedes parts after Singapore GP crash
Mercedes ran out of fresh spares after George Russell's Sprint crash, forcing them to use older parts with less performance
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.

George Russell’s 2026 Singapore Grand Prix was already a certified nightmare on paper. We already knew he had to swallow a massive 60-place engine penalty, fought a brake pedal that decided to go squishy, and spent two hours baking in the cockpit while a ruptured drink bottle leaked mystery fluid all over him.
But thanks to some fresh intel from the German paddock insiders, it turns out his Sunday drive was actually even harder than it looked.
After Russell binned his car into the barriers during Saturday's chaotic sprint race, he didn't just bruise his ego - he completely wiped out the Brackley squad's inventory of fresh carbon fibre.

When the Mercedes mechanics dragged Russell's wrecked W17 back into the garage on Saturday night, the repair bill was massive. According to a report from Auto Motor und Sport, the team was forced to replace the front wing, the floor, the front suspension, and the entire rear section of the car.
The catch? The crash chewed through so much inventory that the team completely ran out of brand-new spares.
Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, George Russell, Mercedes

Instead of bolting on fresh, factory-crisp components, the engineers had to go rummaging through the back of the garage to rebuild the car using previously used parts. Basically, Mercedes had to send Russell out to race on Sunday in a certified pre-owned Frankenstein car.

Before F1 Twitter fires up the conspiracy theories about Mercedes actively sabotaging Russell to favour Kimi Antonelli, let's look at the facts. The second-hand parts bolted onto Russell's chassis were the exact same aerodynamic specification as the fresh ones.

However, Formula 1 cars are violently abusive machines. Carbon fibre flexes, floors scrape across the pavement, and suspension arms get hammered over kerbs. AMuS noted that because these scavenged components had already been through the wringer on previous race weekends, they inherently offered less raw performance than a brand-new set.

Suddenly, Toto Wolff getting on the microphone and calling Russell's P9 finish a successful "damage limitation" makes a whole lot more sense. Slashing your way from 19th on the grid to score points on a street track is tough enough. Doing it in a cobbled-together car that has lost a fraction of its aerodynamic bite because the parts are worn out is actually pretty impressive.

Next time you lock up and wreck your car in the F1 video game and just casually hit the "Flashback" button, spare a thought for the real-life mechanics who have to physically glue these things back together at 2am.
keyPointsZh: 这是由于赛车在事故中受损。
keyPointsEn: The car was damaged in the accident.

detailZh: 红牛车队在美国大奖赛上展示了引人注目的白色一级方程式赛车服，粉丝呼吁匹配的涂装
红牛车队公布了为美国大奖赛特别定制的白色赛车服
对于红牛车队的粉丝来说，关注红牛车队，了解一级方程式新闻、车手更新、技术洞察和米尔顿凯恩斯的分析与赛事分析。
红牛车队在奥斯汀即将举行的一级方程式美国大奖赛上揭幕了全部白色的赛车服，暗示可能为美洲赛车场的赛事引入匹配的一次性涂装。
四次冠军得主马克斯·维斯塔潘和他的队友伊萨克·哈迪亚在社交媒体上分享了一段展示新赛车服的视频。白色设计配有醒目的蓝色装饰和复古风格的缝制合作伙伴徽章。
新的赛车服让粉丝呼吁匹配的车队涂装。一位粉丝评论道：“现在白色公牛？！？！请吗？？！！”，另一位补充说：“现在用这个做一个类似的涂装。”
“有特别的涂装吗？”有人发帖询问，另一条评论写道：“刚刚想起今年我们还没有小红牛 22的特别涂装……COTA有什么计划？”
其他反应包括：“哦我的，请让赛车是白色的！”和“VCARB的赛车服也是白色的；我如何在赛道上找到这些人？”
美国大奖赛定于10月23日至25日举行，这将紧随维斯塔潘连续两次大奖赛胜利之后。他在新加坡大奖赛周末表现出色，赢得了冲刺赛的杆位，并最终夺冠，同时还赢得了大奖赛的杆位，这也是他职业生涯中第一次赢得大奖赛的杆位。
尽管红牛车队近期战绩出色，但目前他们在车队积分榜上排名第四，积分为332分。梅赛德斯车队以578分领先，法拉利车队以444分排名第二，麦凯轮车队以339分排名第三。
维斯塔潘在车手积分榜上排名第四，积分为221分，落后积分榜领跑者基米·安东内利119分。梅赛德斯车队的乔治·拉塞尔排名第二，法拉利车队的刘易斯·汉密尔顿排名第三。哈迪尔因手腕受伤缺席了三次大奖赛周末，目前排名第八，积分为97分。
detailEn: Red Bull reveals striking white F1 race suits for US GP as fans call for matching livery
Red Bull has unveiled special white race suits for the United States Grand Prix
For Red Bull fans. Keeping watch on Red Bull Racing, with F1 news, driver updates, technical insight and race analysis from Milton Keynes.

Red Bull has unveiled all-white race suits for the upcoming Formula 1 United States Grand Prix in Austin, hinting that a matching one-off livery could also be introduced for the race at the Circuit of the Americas.

Four-time champion Max Verstappen and his team-mate Isack Hadjar showed off the new race suits in a video shared on the team's social media platforms. The white design features bold blue accents and vintage-style sewn-on partner badges.
The new race suits have left fans calling for a matching livery. "WHITE BULL NOW?!?! PLEASE??!?!!" one fan commented, while another added: "Now do a similar livery with this."
"There's a special livery, right?" someone else posted, and another comment read: "Just remembered we've not had a special livery of the RB 22 this year... anything cooking in COTA?"
Further reactions included: "Oh my, please let the car be white!" and "VCARB's suits are white as well; how am I gonna find these guys on the track?"

The United States Grand Prix, scheduled for 23-25 October, will follow back-to-back grand prix wins for Verstappen. He dominated the Singapore Grand Prix weekend, claiming pole position for the sprint race, which he won, and pole position for the grand prix, which he went on to win for the first time in his career.

Despite its recent run of wins, Red Bull currently sits fourth in the constructors' championship with 332 points. Mercedes leads with 578 points, and Ferrari and McLaren follow in second and third with 444 and 339 points, respectively.

Verstappen is fourth in the drivers' standings with 221 points, 119 points behind championship leader Kimi Antonelli. Mercedes' George Russell is second and Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton is third. Hadjar is eighth with 97 points, having missed three grand prix weekends due to a wrist injury.

items.originalTitle: McLaren’s Oscar Piastri conquers the dirt in F1 and MotoGP crossover
detailZh: 麦凯伦车手奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂里在F1和MotoGP的跨界越野赛事中征服越野赛道
奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂里在Quad Lock的Young Guns 2活动中与MotoGP的佩德罗·阿科斯塔展开了一场史诗般的越野赛车对决
赛车文化超越赛道，涉及车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计以及那些让赛车运动不仅仅是一项运动的故事
我们知道现代F1车手都讨厌输，无论是摩纳哥大奖赛、他们在模拟器上的F1比赛，还是与MotoGP骑手的越野赛车比赛，他们都会全力以赴
当Quad Lock决定让麦凯轮车手奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂和MotoGP sensation佩德罗·阿科斯塔在《Young Guns Part 2》中重聚时，那种竞争的势头表现得淋漓尽致。他们把价值数百万美元的赛车换成相同的Segway超级反派越野车，这两位全球赛车运动明星在法国里维埃拉的Monti MX赛道上，为了解决他们2024年第一次卡丁车挑战赛中的恩怨而展开对决。
皮亚斯蒂在自己的主场沥青赛道上主导了最初的卡丁车挑战赛，但在Monti MX的土质赛道上，他面临的是完全不同的挑战。这里有巨大的跳跃、深深的凹槽和滑溜的弯道，你可能会认为阿科斯塔——一个以驾驶300马力摩托车为生的人——会有明显的优势。
阿科斯塔显然对越野车上的安全特性比他通常使用的两轮火箭船感到更加舒适。
“我感觉太安全了。就像，如果我翻车，我不会头朝地撞到地上，你知道吗？”这位MotoGP明星开玩笑说，并指出四点安全带和防滚架比皮夹克和安全帽有了巨大的提升。
皮亚斯特里，另一方面，他只是很高兴自己不必平衡车辆。
“我觉得它还能保持四轮行驶对我来说是好事。实际上它在泥土上，而我从未在泥土上开过车……这对我来说不是什么好事，”皮亚斯特里在比赛前承认道。
由冒险骑手和电视主持人Charley Boorman主持的比赛包括短距离冲刺、速度陷阱和最后的两圈大奖赛。
皮亚斯特里很快证明了他是一个快速学习者，赢得了短距离冲刺和速度陷阱的挑战。但真正的戏剧性事件发生在最后的Grand Prix赛事中，Acosta在试图追回地盘时用力过猛。
“我在第一个发夹弯处犯了一个错误，然后我只是在尝试弥补我失去的时间，我差点就把自己送上了绝路，”阿科斯塔笑着回忆起一次恐怖的高速跳跃。'我真的很接近让赛车翻转到前面。“'
皮亚斯特里展现出了那种赢得九场F1大奖赛胜利的冷静、流畅的驾驶风格，他完美地保持了冷静。他以1分53秒的成绩冲过终点线，击败了阿科斯塔的1分54秒的疯狂表现，赢得了整体年轻枪手的冠军。“
接下来是什么？
随着皮亚斯特里获得胜利，自然而然的问题是，这两位明星如何在潜在的年轻枪手第三部分中解决平局。“
阿科斯塔渴望使比赛场地公平，他建议最简单获胜的方式是在下次比赛时让他们两人都骑上两轮摩托车。但皮亚斯特里立即打消了看到他骑 dirt bike 的任何希望。
"如果我们这么做，我认为麦凯轮可能不会那么高兴，" 阿科斯塔开玩笑说，皮亚斯特里微笑着补充道，"不，我不这么认为，" 他更愿意保持自己的赛车合同完整。"我仍然开放接受四轮挑战，但我们必须继续做《年轻枪手3》来尝试看看我是否能赢得一些东西，" 阿科斯塔总结道。
目前，比分已经确定。如果你想看到一名MotoGP车手在几乎翻车之前，在并排的越野车中能抓到多少空气，你可以在Quad Lock的YouTube频道上观看《年轻枪手2》的全场对决。
detailEn: McLaren’s Oscar Piastri conquers the dirt in F1 and MotoGP crossover
Oscar Piastri takes on MotoGP’s Pedro Acosta in an epic dirt buggy showdown for Quad Lock's Young Guns 2
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.

If there's one thing we know about modern Formula 1 drivers, it's that they hate losing. It doesn't matter if it's the Monaco Grand Prix, a round of F1 on their sim rigs, or a dirt buggy race against a MotoGP rider - they are going to absolutely send it.

That competitive streak was on full display when Quad Lock decided to reunite McLaren's Oscar Piastri and MotoGP sensation Pedro Acosta for Young Guns Part 2. Trading in their multi-million-dollar race machines for identical Segway Super Villain off-road buggies, the two global motorsport stars hit the Monti MX track on the French Riviera to settle a score from their first go-karting challenge back in 2024.

While Piastri dominated the original karting challenge on his home turf of asphalt, the dirt track at Monti MX presented a totally different beast. With massive jumps, deep ruts, and slippery corners, you'd think Acosta - a guy who wrestles 300-horsepower motorcycles for a living - would have a clear advantage.
Acosta certainly felt more comfortable with the buggies' safety features compared to his usual two-wheeled rocket ships.

"I feel too safe. Like, if I flip, I will not hit my head with the ground, you know?" the MotoGP star joked, noting that a four-point harness and a rollcage is a massive upgrade from a leather suit and a helmet.
Piastri, on the other hand, was just glad he didn't have to balance the vehicle.
"I feel like the fact it's still on four wheels is good for me. Fact it's on dirt, and that I've never driven on dirt... that's not in my thing," Piastri admitted before the race.
Hosted by adventure rider and TV presenter Charley Boorman, the competition consisted of a sprint, a speed trap, and a final two-lap Grand Prix.

Piastri quickly proved that he’s a fast learner, taking both the sprint race and the speed trap challenges. But the real drama unfolded during the final Grand Prix event, where Acosta pushed a little too hard trying to make up ground.

"I make a mistake going down to the first hairpin, and then I was just trying to recover the time that I lost, and I was close enough to kill myself," Acosta laughed, recounting a terrifying, high-speed launch off a jump. "I was really close to flip the car to the front".

Piastri, displaying the ice-cold, smooth driving style that has earned him nine F1 Grand Prix wins, stayed perfectly calm. He crossed the line with a 1:53 lap time, beating Acosta’s wild 1:54 run to claim the overall Young Guns crown.
What's next?
With Piastri taking the win, the natural question is how the two stars will settle the tiebreaker in a potential Young Guns Part 3.
Acosta, eager to level the playing field, suggested the easiest way to win is to put them both on two wheels next time. But Piastri immediately shut down any hopes of seeing him on a dirt bike.

"I think McLaren will not be so happy if we go for it," Acosta joked, with Piastri adding, "No, I don't think so," with a smile, preferring to keep his racing contract intact. "I still open for four-wheel challenge, but we'll have to keep doing Young Guns Part 3 to try if I see if I win something," Acosta concluded.

For now, the score is settled. If you want to see exactly how much air a MotoGP rider can catch in a side-by-side buggy before nearly rolling it, you can catch the full Young Guns 2 showdown on Quad Lock's YouTube channel.

detailZh: 乔治·拉塞尔瞄准美国站应对即将到来的梅赛德斯引擎网格处罚
乔治·拉塞尔确认另一场引擎网格处罚即将到来，但梅赛德斯计划在拉斯维加斯承担损失。
对于梅赛德斯车迷来说，这里是关于银箭的最新消息，包括F1新闻、车手更新、赛车发展和比赛分析，来自布拉克利和布里克斯沃斯。
在2026赛季的这个阶段，乔治·拉塞尔几乎与FIA裁判员成了朋友。在新加坡大奖赛中，由于更换了大量动力单元部件，他遭受了惊人的60位发车位置下降，你可能会认为这位英国车手会尽可能地远离发车区末尾。
再想想吧。
梅赛德斯正在准备在年底前再安装一个升级的动力单元部件，这意味着拉塞尔不得不吞下苦果，并接受又一次的排位下降。但这一次，布拉克利车队不会随便承受打击。他们正故意等待拉斯维加斯大道的霓虹灯亮起时才采取行动。
在接受天空体育F1采访时，拉塞尔确认，虽然另一个与引擎相关的处罚不可避免，但梅赛德斯已经赢得了战术上的喘息空间来选择他们的战场。
“说实话，现在可能是在赛季的后期，也许是在拉斯维加斯。但它在某个时候会出现，”拉塞尔解释说。“现在我们可以选择何时接受它，我们将选择稍微容易一些的赛道[来超越]。”
这里的逻辑很难被反驳。在一个狭窄、技术性强的赛道上受到引擎处罚，本质上就是报名参加一场长达两小时的游行，被困在中游DRS车队后面。新加坡已经用这种方式让梅赛德斯学到了这个教训；尽管拉塞尔的车速比他前面的车快近1.5秒一圈，但污染的气流尾流整晚都困住了他，限制了他的恢复速度，最终排名第九。
另一方面，拉斯维加斯基本上是一条直线赛道，有几个90度的弯道和一个球体。在1.9公里的全速直道上，搭载新鲜动力和DRS的梅赛德斯应该能够毫无困难地穿越车队。
即将到来的升级是梅赛德斯在赛季末积极开发的一部分。在新加坡进行了分设配置后——在那里，赛道工程总监安德鲁·肖夫林确认基米·安东内利的升级版W17“显然比另一个更快”——车队希望确保两位车手在最后一段都有最锋利的工具。
安东内利有足够的奢侈来捍卫他的102分冠军领先优势，并在奥斯汀追逐可能的冠军加冕，而拉塞尔则一直在做不引人注目的脏活，测试硬件，更换部件，并在维修区处罚中挣扎。
通过将即将到来的动力单元处罚推迟到拉斯维加斯，梅赛德斯避免了在奥斯汀、墨西哥城和英特拉戈斯这些赛道上浪费积分——在这些赛道上，赛道位置至关重要，超车更加困难。
如果拉塞尔在赛季结束前还要从最后一排发车一次，那么在拉斯维加斯的灯光下，带着一台全新的引擎进行比赛可能会给粉丝带来今年最精彩的时刻。
detailEn: George Russell targets US race for looming Mercedes engine grid penalty
George Russell confirms another engine grid penalty is coming, but Mercedes plans to take the hit in Las Vegas
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.

At this point in the 2026 season, George Russell is practically on a first-name basis with the FIA stewards. After eating a staggering 60-place grid drop at the Singapore Grand Prix to replace an entire pharmacy of power unit components, you would think the British driver would want to stay as far away from the back of the grid as humanly possible.
Think again.

Mercedes is preparing to bolt on another upgraded power unit element before the year wraps up, meaning Russell will have to take his medicine and accept yet another grid drop. But this time around, the Brackley squad isn't just going to take the hit anywhere. They are deliberately waiting for the neon lights of the Las Vegas Strip to pull the trigger.
Speaking to Sky Sports F1, Russell confirmed that while another engine-related penalty is inevitable, Mercedes has earned the tactical breathing room to pick their battlefield.

"It will probably be later in the season now, to be honest — maybe Las Vegas. But it will be there at some point," Russell explained. "Now we have the choice to take it when we wish, and we will choose slightly easier tracks [to overtake at]."

The logic here is pretty hard to argue with. Taking an engine penalty at a tight, technical circuit is essentially signing up for a two-hour parade stuck behind a midfield DRS train. Singapore already taught Mercedes that lesson the hard way; despite Russell having nearly 1.5 seconds a lap in raw pace over the cars in front of him, the dirty air wake trapped him all night, capping his recovery drive at P9.

Las Vegas, on the other hand, is basically a drag strip with a couple of 90-degree corners and a sphere. With a massive 1.9-kilometer flat-out blast down the Strip, a Mercedes carrying fresh horsepower and DRS should have zero trouble carving through the pack.

The looming upgrade is part of Mercedes' aggressive late-season development push. After running split setups in Singapore—where Trackside Engineering Director Andrew Shovlin confirmed that Kimi Antonelli’s upgraded W17 was "clearly the faster of the two"—the team wants to ensure both drivers have the sharpest tools available for the final stretch.

While Antonelli has the luxury of defending his 102-point championship lead and chasing a potential title coronation in Austin, Russell has been doing the unglamorous dirty work of testing hardware, cycling through components, and battling through grid penalties.

By pushing the upcoming power unit penalty back to Vegas, Mercedes avoids throwing away points at Austin, Mexico City, and Interlagos—venues where track position is king and passing is far more difficult.

If Russell has to start from the back of the grid one more time before the season shuts down, doing it under the Las Vegas lights with a fresh engine might just give fans the most entertaining charge of the year.
